verdict.rationale: The chip itself has no API, but its developer ecosystem (Qualcomm developer portal, AI Engine Direct SDK, AI Hub) makes this a fair question. AI Hub offers sample app repositories with code templates and step-by-step guides, plus cloud-hosted devices for profiling and running inference, which gives some runnable-example support. There is no evidence of an interactive API reference, and OpenAPI/swagger probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive, browsable API reference; in-page runnable examples tied to API docs; a machine-readable API spec; independent hands-on corroboration.
